About NeuralVarsity

An AI education platform built around doing the work.

NeuralVarsity designs industry-focused programs in data analytics, data science, applied machine learning and AI agents. Each one is sequenced day by day — concept, lab, project, proof — so learners leave with skills they can demonstrate, not just certificates they can frame.

Tools & frameworks

What we believe

Six principles behind every program.

01

Build to learn

Every concept earns its place by being used — in a lab, a deliverable or a capstone. You learn AI by building with it.

02

AI-native curricula

Generative AI is woven into every program, from AI-assisted analysis to Transformers, RAG and autonomous agents.

03

Radical transparency

Every session of every program is published, searchable and downloadable — so you know exactly what you’ll learn before you apply.

04

Responsible by default

Bias, hallucinations, guardrails, security and human oversight are taught alongside the technology, not as an afterthought.

05

Production, not just notebooks

Git, APIs, deployments, Docker and MLOps — so the work you build actually runs in the real world.

06

A path for every starting point

From spreadsheets to engineering-grade AI, and from six-week sprints to six-month deep dives.

The NeuralVarsity ladder

Four programs. One connected path.

Start where you are. Each program stands on its own — and together they map the full journey from data to autonomous AI.

  1. 01 · 3 Months · 60 sessions Data Analyst with GenAI Analytics, BI dashboards & reporting
  2. 02 · 6 Months · 120 sessions Data Science with GenAI Machine learning, deep learning, NLP & GenAI
  3. 03 · 6 Months · 120 sessions Applied AI & Machine Learning AI engineering, LLMs, agents & MLOps
  4. 04 · 6 Weeks · 36 sessions AI Agents & Automation Agents, automation & AI-powered apps
